tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
ALL TERMS AND CONDITIONS AS PER THE TENDER/RFP DOCUMENT

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should have supplied furniture items in single order for a total value not less than Rs.100 Lakhs to any State or Central government institutions/Organizations in Karnataka during the preceding 3 years i.e.2022-23, 2023-24 & 2024-25 as a proof the bidder should upload Original PO along with Satisfactory Work completion certificate.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant document shall be uploaded

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Tenderer shall also produce satisfactory work completion certificate(s) issued by the concerned government, public sector undertaking along with a certified copy of the previous supply orders issued to them by the concerned state. Central government departments and public sector units.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant document shall be uploaded

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer should be a manufacturer who must have manufactured, tested and supplied the Furnitures similar to the type specified in the Schedule of Requirements (Section V) upto at least 80 % (40% with respect to Micro and Small Enterprises) of the quantity required, in any one of the last 3 years 2022-23, 2023-24 & 2024-25 (in any one of the last 2 years for Micro and Small Enterprises). The items offered for supply must be of mostrecent series models incorporating the latest improvements in design

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant document shall be uploaded as per tender document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Tenders of tenderers quoting as authorized representative or authorized regular dealer of a manufacturer can also be considered provided the manufacturer furnishes authorization in the prescribed format assuring full guarantee and warranty obligations as per GCC and SCC and The tenderer, as authorized representative has supplied, installed and commissioned satisfactorily at least 30% of the Furnitures similar to the type specified in the schedule of requirements in any one of the last 3 years 2022-23, 2023-24 & 2024-25 in which 30% of quantity must have been supplied by the dealer along with 80% manufacturer performance
